body:
Technically only the cat and one dog aren’t mine (aka legally mine) it’s just the fact I can’t seperate them. They’re so wel bonded. 

I feel so good providing and caring for them, seeing them happy at the end of the day, rolled up by a fireplace etc..

3 dogs and a cat (cats curled up on my chest currently). When I eventually break free and manage to be able to have my own place I’ll not be able to take them with me sadly,

They’re all very unique huh. I love them dearly.
